data.title: Our Partners
data.subtitle: We collaborate with industry-leading brands and companies to deliver exceptional value and innovation.

benefits.title: Premium Load Access
benefits.desc: Our driver network gets priority access to the highest-paying loads from top-tier brokers.

benefits.title: Verified & Safe Loads
benefits.desc: Every load from our partners is verified, insured, and background-checked before dispatch.

benefits.title: Faster Payments
benefits.desc: Our partner relationships include quick-pay options — reducing your cash flow wait times.

benefits.title: Nationwide Coverage
benefits.desc: Coast-to-coast lanes in all 48 contiguous states through our established partner network.

benefits.title: Dedicated Partner Support
benefits.desc: A dedicated GFS liaison manages your account and resolves issues before they escalate.

benefits.title: Live Performance Reports
benefits.desc: Real-time dashboards and monthly reports showing lane performance, reliability, and earnings.

howItWorks.title: Apply to Partner
howItWorks.desc: Submit your company information and fleet details through our simple partner application.

howItWorks.title: Qualification Review
howItWorks.desc: Our team reviews your DOT compliance, insurance, and safety ratings within 48 hours.

howItWorks.title: Network Integration
howItWorks.desc: We connect your fleet with our broker and shipper network, matching loads to your lanes.

howItWorks.title: Start Earning
howItWorks.desc: Begin receiving consistent, verified loads with weekly settlements and dedicated support.
